submitted_root_cause: The cartservice application is experiencing severe memory pressure (97.3% utilization) and CPU throttling (26.8%), leading to Out-Of-Memory (OOM) kills and container restarts, causing one pod to be unhealthy and in a 'BackOff' state. This prevents the service from handling traffic.
submitted_action: Increase the memory limits for the 'cartservice' deployment to prevent Out-Of-Memory kills and potentially adjust CPU limits/requests to alleviate throttling.
